summary: Ran M3-S05's molecular tests from the build directory. XML: 3 of 3 files under artefacts/M3-S05/ (the flexipage, the Opportunity object override file, and package.xml) parsed with ElementTree. Manifest: this step's type is ui, a metadata step type, and package.xml exists under its own artefacts (declared in outputs[]), so the always-on check ran for real rather than skipping - FlexiPage member Opportunity_Enterprise_Record_Page and CustomObject member Opportunity each derive from a file present under artefacts/M3-S05/ and each appears explicitly (no wildcard) in package.xml, both directions consistent, no metadata-api-coverage-gaps exclusion needed. The one declared checker, check_lightning_record_page_configuration.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M3-S05, ran verbatim from the build directory and exited 0 ('No errors found (0 warning(s)).'), matching metadata-builder's own reported exit code from its build run. check-outputs confirmed ok:true (no missing/empty/malformed) and artefact_hashes were recorded for all 4 declared outputs via check-outputs --hashes. No command-type acceptance test is declared. Two manual acceptance tests are deferred to the M3 milestone gate, never ticked here; both are Given/When/Then-shaped with a named observable outcome per admin/acceptance-criteria-given-when-then, and both were spot-checked against the artefacts as due diligence (not part of the pass/fail contract): the object file's exactly-two-actionOverrides claim and deploy-order.md's app-override-wins caveat both match; the flexipage's subheader/sidebar placement, discountThreshold value and per-componentInstance identifier length claims all match. results.json passed:true (failed[] empty), so the step was moved built -> tested via set-status. Two UNVERIFIED markers the builder left inline on the flexipage (the sidebar region name for this template, and the c: prefix on the custom LWC) are, per the operator's framing of this run, the org's to settle and were not evaluated as part of this test pass - they are outside what this checker validates (identifiers, region capacity, operators and assignment, not a template's real region set or a component namespace against an org's component list) and outside this agent's scope regardless.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran or was correctly classified as manual (Step 7 HIGH row): both always-on checks completed (xml parsed all 3 files; manifest ran as a real two-directional check, not a skip, and came back consistent), the one declared checker's exit code (0) was observed directly by this agent from a verbatim re-run in the build directory, check-outputs reported ok:true with no missing/empty/malformed outputs, and no command-type test was refused because none is declared. Nothing here forced a MEDIUM or LOW reading.

process_observations.observation: check_lightning_record_page_configuration.py reproduced the exact exit code and message metadata-builder's own envelope reported ('No errors found (0 warning(s)).', exit 0) when re-run independently, verbatim, from the build directory.

Both deferred manual lines matched the artefacts on every claim checked at spot-check: the object file's exactly-two-actionOverrides shape, deploy-order.md's app-override-wins caveat, the flexipage's subheader/sidebar component placement, the discountThreshold value of 20, and all three componentInstance identifiers being present and well under the 120-character API 53.0 ceiling. Unlike a prior step in this build (M3-S04), no undercount or mismatch was found in either line.

This step's manifest check is a clean, literal case rather than an analogized carve-out: metadata-builder is the owning agent and standards/build-orchestration.md Section 5 states every metadata-builder-owned metadata step declares package.xml in outputs[], which this step does and which check-outputs confirmed present and non-empty. No operator instruction or prior-step precedent was needed to resolve how the always-on check should run here, unlike M3-S04's LWC-bundle step in the same build.

The flexipage file carries two builder-authored UNVERIFIED markers (whether flexipage:recordHomeWithSubheaderTemplateDesktop actually provides a region named sidebar, and whether the c: prefix is correct for the custom LWC componentName). Per the operator's framing of this run these are the org's to settle and a parallel mock-deploy dry run may be in flight, but its result was not read as part of this test pass (it writes only under reports/mock-deploy/, not evidence for this agent). Neither the declared checker nor the xml/manifest checks can see either gap: the checker validates identifiers, region capacity, operators and assignment, not a template's real region-name set or a component namespace against an org's actual component list.

set-status's own preflight printed pre-existing WARNs across the plan for undeclared-checker skill citations, two of which are on this step itself (admin/path-and-guidance ships check_path_and_guidance.py, lwc/lwc-base-component-recipes ships check_lwc_base_component_recipes.py) - neither is declared as a checker test on M3-S05 or on milestone M3. Outside this run's scope to fix (this agent runs only what the plan declares) and not introduced by this run, but worth a human decision per build-orchestration.md Section 5's WARN remedy: declare the test with amend-step --add-checker, or drop the skill from skills[] if it was never meant to run.
M3-S05 is now tested; the per-step documentation pass has not run yet.
